description:
Meet Eric and Woody, two mischievous friends trying to sneak into the girls locker room. Years later, they are the (kinda) heroic duo Quantum and Woody and they are falling out of an airplane. Too bad that there's only one parachute to go around?

Hijinks at 40,000 feet at Quantum and Woody try to escape a trap set for them by Terrence Magnum!

Plus Mark's Silly Sketchbook, featuring outtakes and early designs for the series.

It's the unforgettable origin of the most outrageous superhero duo in comics history! After 15 years apart, childhood friends Eric and Woody reunite after the mysterious double murder of their fathers. Setting off to investigate a laboratory tied to their deaths, this pair are about to undergo an startling accident that will change their lives - and bind them together - forever.

15 years after a painful parting of the ways, childhood friends Eric Henderson and Woodrow van Chelton find themselves suspects in the mysterious deaths of their fathers.

While attempting to clear their names, tension mounts as the serious-minded Eric struggles with the comedic antics of Woody.

Their investigations lead them to their fathers' business, Affirm Research, the enigmatic (or possibly just boring) David Warrant, and an accidental exposure to an unknown energy source that will leave them forever changed... and forever stuck with one another.
Woody and Quantum have switched bodies, and let me tell you... it's ugly.

issue_title: Where the Streets Have No Name
description: Christmas brings Woody (in Eric's body) to a strange ritual--a vigil for one of his closest friends, killed some years before--and reignites Woody's overwhelming desire for vengeance. Meanwhile, Eric (in Woody's body) struggles to find a solution to their switched body dilemma, and wrestles with the decision of whether or not to tell Woody a long-kept secret.
What if your best friend bit you on the face? What happened to Woody (in Eric's body)? This issue, we find out Eric's most closely guarded secret.

Finally, Quantum & Woody get returned to their rightful bodies. If you ask us, it's about time. Eric (or is it Woody, we're so confused) recruits the love of his life to join the team. Also, an absolutely major turning point in the lives of Eric and Woody.

Woody is out for revenge, and Terrence Magnum, the man who has declared war on our heroes, is the target! Can Quantum keep Woody from going too far? Part one of the epic four part storyline Magnum Force!
Magnum Force Part 2 of 4, "Peace." Magnum's enforcer, War Locke, has taken the team captive and the guys learn the true price of being a superhero.

Magnum Force Part 3 of 4: It's THE FEAR ISSUE- the guys, lost, their weapons and powers having proved useless against a relentless foe, are faced for the first time with the sobering reality of their imminent death (at the hands of War Locke). They become paralyzed by a crushing wave of fear in the final moments of their lives, confronting the true nature of heroism and friendship.

issue_title: Magnum Force The Final Round: Hate
description: Magnum Force Book 4 of 4: Love. The END of Quantum & Woody? The heroes trash their uniforms, tired of attracting bozos and losers and villainous types. They dissolve the partnership, and head to Paris as they make their way home. In Paris they find they can't easily leave the path they've started on, as they find themselves hunted by the police and thrown in jail after having defended themselves from their attackers, only to be bailed out by the LAST person either of them would expect to see, after with they reluctantly resume their heroic identities for one final showdown with Magnum and the deadly WarLocke!

Powerless, and back from the brink of cancellation, Quantum and Woody are hauled in by the police to answer for their brand of vigilante justice. Their only defense? The man called Warrant. But, unfortuantely, he is stranded on the moon?

The team is over, or IS it? Quantum and Woody go their separate ways, with Quantum remaining in Paris to investigate a suspicious-acting Toyo Harada, while Woody heads home for two girls and a pizza. Also, the mysterious immortal named Lysander continues to challenge Warrant's motives, and a BIG secret from the heroes' past continues to unfold!

Quantum & Woody are searching for a murderer. To what lengths will this couple (they're not a couple, really) of mismatched misfits go to discover the killer? Scale the tallest building? Avoid evil children? And the most terrifying question of all - will Woody find a way to stop his costume from riding up on him?

Quantum and Woody deal with the end of their partnership as each adopts a new role: Quantum, setting out to stop Toyo Harada's evil plan (whatever that is), and Woody, who's decided to sue Marble Comix over a comic book they've put out based on Q&W.

Toyo Harada convinces Quantum to re-acquire the Quantum Field energy he and Woody once shared, and the process reaches critical mass just as David "Dave" Warrant's heroic efforts to save the last surviving Eternal Warriors reaches its most volatile phase, and while Woody presses his grievance against a famous comic book editor.

Quantum & Woody span the globe, in search of clues to solve a tragic murder. Along the way they happen to unravel a world-threatening international conspiracy and rack up frequent flyer miles as they criss-cross the world. All this, and Woody buys a goat.

issue_title: Eclipse Book 3: The Mirror Has Four Faces
description: With time running out, Quantum and Woody race to find a way to destroy Dr. Eclipse's ultimate weapon while knowing that, if they succeed, destroying the weapon could also kill Eclipse - Quantum's oldest friend.

There's trouble in paradise. Woody's antics keep the duo from being taken seriously as superheroes. And things only get worse when Quantum and Woody try to defuse a hostage situation in a mall.

Quantum wants to be taken seriously as a hero, and he'll go to any lengths to prove it. But, how can he be taken seriously when he's stuck with Woody? How do they deal with a serious hostage situation in Manhattan Mall? How else? Badly! All this and a goat, too.

Quantum and Woody take on a high profile mission to save America's political elite from terrorists. It's exactly what Eric has always dreamed of?but is it all too good to be true?

Quantum & Woody execute a beautiful plan to stop an evil terrorist from ransoming America's political elite. A flawless mission for the World's Worst superhero team? Do you honestly think so?

Woody is missing and the clock is ticking! If Quantum doesn't find him soon, they will both dissipate into pure energy. Could an old enemy be behind Woody's disappearance?

Time is running out. Woody is missing. Quantum suspects foul play. If Quantum doesn't find Woody soon, they're both royally screwed.

issue_title: Tock: David Warrant Is Not Dead
description: We find out where the heck Woody has been. Quantum & Woody break up. But they aren't a couple... remember that.

Warrant is back with a vengeance! The man once suspected of orchestrating the deaths of Eric and Woody's fathers, has become a mentor to Quantum, leaving Woody in the dust. But never fear, Woody partners up with someone who's got a ton more sense then Quantum.

Woody's dying and his not-so-pretty life is flashing before his eyes. Quantum has brought him to Galloway & Galloway to see if they can save his life. This of course attracts the attention of our favorite kids with attitude... the Troublemakers! Can Zeus: Control save Woody? Will the kids stop harassing Quantum about his cape?
